# CORE-TGT-04

**Where the design shows the target state to be wrong, has that been raised as a consideration to change the target, rather than worked around?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | TGT: Target state |
| Default severity | minor |
| Decided by | A reviewer |
| Reads | `considerations`, `decisions.departure` |

## Why it matters

A target that every design has to work around is not a target. The third of G253's answers is to change the architecture, and it has to be asked for to happen.
